problem.title: The Cheap Fix Trap
problem.description: Buying pre-made templates or outsourcing to traditional agencies that copy-paste thousands of CSS utilities usually ends the same way: fragile code that no one can maintain and poor web performance.
alertList: Pages that take more than 3 seconds to load, losing 40% of visits.
Spaghetti code with duplicated classes, impossible to read or refactor.
Absolute reliance on external plugins and heavy scripts that break layouts.
Budgets fading away in continuous patches without solving the core issue.
protocolList: Obsessive optimization for Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and sub-second times.
Clean, organized Svelte components with encapsulated SCSS styles.
Minimal dependency footprint: only strictly necessary packages.
Proprietary code that you can autonomously maintain and extend in the future.

hero.title: The Dark Lynx Manifesto
hero.description: We believe in honest software, built on solid foundations, free of bloated dependencies, and designed to last.

principles.title: Direct, No-Nonsense Development
principles.description: We don't sell smoke or inflated methodologies. We speak in code and tangible results. We design and implement software that solves real problems without adding unnecessary complexity.

principles.title: Performance as an Absolute Priority
principles.description: Web speed is not a luxury; it's a critical conversion metric. We optimize every byte, image, and request so the experience is instantaneous on any screen and connection.

principles.title: Maintainable Architecture
principles.description: We write CSS/SCSS with clear tokens and Svelte components with single responsibilities. If a developer inspects your project months later, they will know exactly what to touch without breaking anything.

principles.title: Technical Honesty
principles.description: If a simple solution works, we won't recommend a complex multi-thousand dollar architecture. Your long-term success and peace of mind is our main goal.
